name: MuluOS Brand Palette
description: Core brand colors extracted from the MuluOS logo. All values in hex (#RRGGBB) with sRGB RGB equivalents.

primary.role: Primary brand color — deep navy blue. Use for headers, primary buttons, and key UI elements.

primary-light.role: Lighter variant of primary for hover states and secondary surfaces.

primary-dark.role: Darker variant of primary for pressed states and deep backgrounds.

secondary.role: Secondary brand color — bright cyan. Use for highlights, links, and interactive elements.

accent.role: Accent brand color — vibrant mint green. Use for success states, toggles, and CTAs.

accent-warm.role: Warm accent — orange. Use for warnings, destructive actions, and contrasting highlights.

neutral-100.role: White. Page backgrounds, card surfaces in light theme.

neutral-200.role: Cool off-white. Alternating row backgrounds, subtle surfaces.

neutral-300.role: Light gray. Borders, disabled states, dividers.

neutral-700.role: Dark slate. Secondary text, muted icons.

neutral-900.role: Near-black. Primary text, dark theme backgrounds.
